note: By-eye check of the photo outlines of bus shelters, fences, low and retaining walls, garden walls and planters (data/photo/objects-campus.geojson and rest-spaces.geojson) on NGII 2025 chips with the outline drawn over the photo. verdict ok = the outline lies on its photo feature within about 1 m; shift = moved by offsetM [east, south] metres onto the feature (estimated, by eye); reject = the photo shows nothing there (left out). Roofed outlines are compared with the roof (relief lean is removed later as before). No bollards exist in the survey (not resolvable at 0.25 m).
